Definition: to spice; by implication, to embalm; also to ripen
BiblicalUsage: v; 1) to embalm, spice, make spicy; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to spice, make spicy; 1a2) to embalm; 2) (CLBL) to ripen; n m pl abst; 3) (BDB) embalming
